title: barbarea vulgaris subsp. pinnata
intro: Barbarea vulgaris subsp. pinnata, commonly known as cutleaf yellowrocket, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial herb with a rich history of traditional use, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Barbarea vulgaris subsp. pinnata are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
